#### Welcome to my page! {style="margin-top: 0;"}

My research is mainly focused on head shape evolution in vertebrates. I am currently based at the University of Oslo, where I am conducting a project on beak evolution in crossbills.

My field of expertise spans genomics, morphological comparative studies and behavioural approaches.

Find more details on my main projects below.
